reason: Overview serves park/enterprise location and energy/carbon monitoring; relief exaggeration adds no required business function and can overstate terrain variation.
dataSource: ASTER GDEM V3 N32E114 from gscloud.cn
gridSampling: Every 3 original source cells, approximately 90m display spacing
planningBoundaryStatus: Preliminary planning illustration, not surveyed property or legal boundary
method: Sample grid cell centers inside the approximate GCJ-02 planning polygons; P05/P95 describe the central approximately 90% of included cell elevations, not survey accuracy.
limitations: Planning positioning is approximate and may shift sampled cells
Elevation ranges are not slopes; real-world terrain variation cannot be inferred from one exaggerated view
ASTER GDEM can contain anomalies and artifacts; no local ground-height validation was performed
retained: Original archive and cropped GeoTIFF remain in local ignored storage; WGS84 preview grid and provenance remain available in data management.
